@php
    $active = $this->getActiveSectorDashboard();
    $available = $this->getAvailableSectorDashboards();
    $presentation = \Modules\Management\Filament\Support\SectorDashboardPages::forSector($active);
    $compactHeader = $active->value === 'teste' || ($presentation !== null && is_subclass_of(
        $presentation,
        \Modules\Management\Contracts\CompactSectorDashboardPresentation::class,
    ));
@endphp

<div class="fi-page">
    <div class="renew-dashboard-shell fi-fixed-positioning-context w-full min-w-0 space-y-4 sm:space-y-6">
        {{ $this->backofficeDashboardLinks }}

        <div @class(['renew-dashboard-hero p-4 sm:p-5 md:p-6' => ! $compactHeader])>
            <div @class([
                'relative z-10 flex flex-col gap-4',
                'sm:flex-row sm:flex-wrap sm:items-center sm:justify-between' => $compactHeader,
            ])>
                <div class="space-y-1">
                    @if ($compactHeader)
                        <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-gray-950 sm:text-2xl dark:text-gray-50">
                            Dashboard {{ $active->getLabel() }}
                        </h2>
                    @else
                        <p class="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-[0.24em] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                            Dashboard
                        </p>
                        <h2 class="text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-gray-950 min-[480px]:text-2xl dark:text-gray-50">
                            {{ $active->getLabel() }}
                        </h2>
                    @endif
                </div>

                @if (count($available) > 1)
                    <div @class(['flex flex-wrap gap-2', 'sm:ml-auto sm:justify-end' => $compactHeader])>
                        @foreach ($available as $option)
                            <a
                                href="?dashboard={{ $option->value }}"
                                wire:navigate
                                @class([
                                    'rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium',
                                    'bg-primary-600 text-white' => $option === $active,
                                    'bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 dark:bg-white/10 dark:text-gray-200' => $option !== $active,
                                ])
                            >
                                {{ $option->getLabel() }}
                            </a>
                        @endforeach
                    </div>
                @endif

                @unless ($compactHeader)
                    <form wire:submit.prevent="" class="relative">
                        {{ $this->filtersForm }}
                    </form>
                @endunless
            </div>
        </div>

        @if ($compactHeader)
            <form wire:submit.prevent="" class="relative">
                {{ $this->filtersForm }}
            </form>
        @endif

        @if ($this->hasSectorDashboardPresentation())
            {{ $this->sectorWidgets }}
        @else
            <x-filament-widgets::widgets
                :columns="['default' => 1, 'md' => 6, 'lg' => 12]"
                class="gap-4 sm:gap-6"
                :widgets="$this->getSectorDashboardWidgets()"
                :data="['pageFilters' => $this->filters]"
            />
        @endif
    </div>
</div>
